title: Claims Desk Calculation Sheet: Manufacturer Copay Card Reimbursement Amount (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The reimbursement a Manufacturer Copay Card of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs pays on a fill the patient already paid is worked out on this sheet.

**The fill and its patient pay.** The fill being reimbursed is the latest fill of the card's prescription that the fill ledger shows settled by insurance alone, and its patient pay is the patient pay on the paid insurance claim for that fill number. The fill date is the date of that fill.

**The reimbursement.** The reimbursement on a fill the patient already paid is that fill's claim patient pay limited to the reimbursement limit, less the reimbursement minimum pay, and never more than the benefit dollars left on the program, rounded to the cent half up. The reimbursement limit is the program's per-fill benefit maximum, and the reimbursement minimum pay is the program's patient minimum pay.

**Order.** The claim's patient pay is first limited to the reimbursement limit; the reimbursement minimum pay is then taken off that limited amount; the result is finally held to the benefit dollars left on the program and never set below zero, rounded to the cent half up.

**Benefit dollars left.** The benefit dollars left on the program are the credits of its period-opening entries and benefit reversals less its benefit entries and closing entries.

The per-fill benefit maximum and the patient minimum pay are the program's figures on the benefit dollars schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: per-fill benefit maximum $800.00, patient minimum pay $5.00)

| Claim patient pay | Benefit dollars left | Working | Reimbursement |
|---|---|---|---|
| $60.00 | $3000.00 | 60.00 less 5.00 | $55.00 |
| $1200.00 | $3000.00 | limited to 800.00, less 5.00 | $795.00 |
| $1200.00 | $400.00 | 795.00 held to 400.00 | $400.00 |
| $3.00 | $3000.00 | 3.00 less 5.00 is below zero | $0.00 |

**Dollars left (hypothetical ledger):** opening entry $9600.00, reversals $100.00, benefit entries $6000.00, no closing entry: $3700.00 left.
